## Description {#details}

<p>A file system that allows overlaying one <span class="doxyComputerOutput">AbstractFileSystem</span> on top of another.</p>


<p>Consists of a stack of &gt;=1 <span class="doxyComputerOutput"><a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/classes/llvm/vfs/filesystem">FileSystem</a></span> objects, which are treated as being one merged file system. When there is a directory that exists in more than one file system, the <span class="doxyComputerOutput"><a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/classes/llvm/vfs/overlayfilesystem">OverlayFileSystem</a></span> contains a directory containing the union of their contents. The attributes (permissions, etc.) of the top-most (most recently added) directory are used. When there is a file that exists in more than one file system, the file in the top-most file system overrides the other(s).</p>


<p>Definition at line 391 of file <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/files/include/include/llvm/include/llvm/support/virtualfilesystem-h">VirtualFileSystem.h</a>.</p>
